identity.description: iPayX Protocol (operating at ipayx.ai, registered as 11850091 Canada Inc. per directory listings): a 'MCP-Native FX Audit Engine' that scores bank/card FX transactions against live mid-market rates to surface hidden fees. Not a payments processor. Note: a different, unrelated 'iPayX' (ipayx.vercel.app) is a testnet USDC invoicing app; it has no public API.
identity.identity_notes: The task's hint domain ipayx.ai/docs returns 'Oops! Page not found' in the fetch, but ipayx.ai home, /docs/api, and /pricing describe the FX audit product. Name collision: ipayx.vercel.app (USDC invoicing, testnet-only) is a different product and was excluded. FINTRAC MSB registration C10001283 is self-claimed and not verified against the FINTRAC registry.

auth.token_refresh: unknown (static key; no refresh flow described)
auth.scopes_notes: No scopes documented. Keys start with ipx_live_ and are sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Unknown whether there is a test/sandbox key type.

access.production_restrictions: Pricing page says 'Upgrade to signed reports or production-grade API', suggesting production API access is a paid upgrade. Page metadata (unverified) claims 'API plans from $99/mo', but this is not in the visible pricing body. The API key button links to the pricing page, and the key-issuance process is not described. The sandbox is the no-signup MCP test page at /mcp-test; there is no documented REST sandbox.

write_ops: POST /audit/document (batch audit of parsed transactions, e.g. CSV/QuickBooks/Xero exports)
api.rate_limits: No numeric limit published. 429 rate_limit_exceeded is described as 'Too many requests in the last 60 seconds.' Free MCP audit tool: 3 per IP per calendar month.
api.limitations: Only three REST endpoints. Base URL is a Supabase edge function (https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1). MCP is a separate protocol and is not listed as a REST protocol. No SDK languages are named; code samples are cURL, JavaScript, and Python. Webhook event listed: audit.completed.

open_questions: Whether API keys are self-serve and free, or require a paid plan or sales contact. Pricing page does not say; the 'API plans from $99/mo' figure appears only in unverified metadata.
Whether a free test/sandbox API key exists for the REST API (only the no-signup MCP sandbox was found).
SDK languages: none named; only cURL, JavaScript, and Python code samples and a Node.js webhook signature snippet.
Whether the ipayx.ai/docs path is a dead link (404 on fetch), so the documented path may be /docs/api or /docs/mcp-server instead.
Relationship between the official mcp.ipayx.ai endpoint, the workers.dev mirror, and the io.github.Ipayx-stellar connector is unclear.
Repo license is not shown; the GitHub About section has no description.
The FINTRAC MSB registration C10001283 was not verified against the FINTRAC public registry.
Quotes were taken from summarized fetch output and were not verified character-for-character against live pages.
